meta.name: trojan_horse_in_troy
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

programs.brief: The colossal hollow Trojan horse constructed from weathered ship timber planks (api.theme.wood.planks) on a massive wheeled timber chassis, with a hidden underbelly trapdoor hatch and ladder rungs.
Deserted Greek siege camp traces with cold campfire ashes, overturned supply crates, abandoned weapon stands, and stripped tent posts along the shoreline.

tokens.terrain: a walled bronze-age citadel on a coastal rise above the Aegean plain and shore
tokens.icons: the colossal wooden horse standing inside the city gates in the public square; massive stone circuit walls with defensive gate towers; a royal megaron palace presiding over flat-roofed stone quarters; deserted Greek encampment traces along the coast
tokens.event_scene: dead of night stillness just before the hidden Greek warriors descend from the wooden horse to unbar the gates

root.label: The Citadel of Troy on the night of the Horse
